requirement: The Own domain card footer tells a Cloudflare customer to keep the CNAME DNS only (grey cloud)

oracle.ref: PR #1163 (fix); fix evidence: Dev machine 10/10/2026: www.genieos.ai stayed Pending Validation (HTTP) with the CNAME proxied and went active/active within minutes once it was DNS only; the card never said so. Product owner 11/10/2026: the hint goes in the footer, not on the CNAME row label.
oracle.invariant: S1: in English and every other language domains.dnsOnly names Cloudflare, CNAME, DNS only and the grey cloud, and the four footer keys keep their placeholders; in every other language the CNAME row label is back to its short wording. S2: no row label carries the instruction (no DNS only, no Cloudflare). S3: a dns-only line follows the checked-at line directly (unchecked too); there is none on an unsupported or lapsed domain.
